rule: the crossword is the site map: each answer is one piece of work, each clue is its result in plain words
title: Fjalëkryq
description: The site map is an Albanian crossword. The identity line sits over the board. The right column opens on one shipped client product with its result, its scope and a real public screen (Bayyinah TV at load), then the other six client results. Ten answers are filled at the start (seven client, three own); twenty are a real puzzle: their names stay hidden until the visitor fills them in, or presses Show the answer or Solve it.
signature: Press Try VIVAFRESH (or type it anywhere): nine letters fall from above the board into their cells with a two-bounce settle, the word floods blue in a wave, and Viva Fresh swaps into the lead panel with its store screens.
hookSentence: His portfolio is an Albanian crossword: the letters of a project fall into place, and twenty answers are a real puzzle you can play.
craftGate: pass: 375/390/540/1024/1280/1440, no horizontal overflow, CLS 0.0000 (0.0001 at 540 and 1024, font swap), 44 px targets, visible focus, board does not trap Tab, reduced motion places letters at once, no WebGL, no sound, own JS 11.9 kB + CSS 4.3 kB gzip
holdback: Seniority still rests on result and scope lines, not on a case narrative. On a phone the board is a fitted map (cells about 11 px), so the falling letters are small there; the work list carries the phone page. At 1280 x 800 the last client row sits one short scroll down. EPUBREADER is still a stack word among the hidden answers.

fixed: Real work with no typing: the right column opens on Bayyinah TV with its result, scope and the public landing page; all seven client results stay on the first screen at 1440 (last row y 834-888)

Phone board fits the width (no side crop), touch-action auto, cells take no pointer, no drag on touch; swipes scroll the page
